name: request-docking
change_note: Initial docking procedure requested by the Captain; validate against a live session before marking reported_working.

procedure.title: Request station docking
procedure.summary: Use discovered Elite action names and observed Contacts menus to request and verify clearance.
procedure.when_to_use: The Captain requests docking or station clearance now.
steps: Read current instruments and screenshot; verify intended station, normal space and distance within 7.5 km.
Discover exact action names with list_bindings when advertised; FocusLeftPanel opens the left panel. PanelLeft and UI panel left are not action IDs.
Read and follow the docking guide. Open Contacts and select the observed station using one observed step at a time.
Select Request Docking without asking for an extra approval: the current docking order already authorizes this.
Verify clearance, pad/timer or a fresh DockingGranted event before reporting success.
success_checks: An observed grant and assigned pad/timer, or a fresh DockingGranted journal event.
stop_conditions: Unknown target/range, supercruise, already docked, unexpected menu, or uncertain input outcome.
Actual missing keyboard mapping or unsupported key; discover mappings before concluding a control is unavailable.
